knownIssues.description: Option 'NO' Level and Characterisation are runtime expressions testing Q_01_009 against the invalid literals 'INTENSIVE'/'SEMI_INTENSIVE'/'SUPER_INTENSIVE'. Q_01_009's real values are SILVO, EXT, INT, SEMI_INT, RICE-SHR, SPR_INT, so the `in` test can never be true and both expressions always fall through to `undefined` (dead code, preserved verbatim).

Option 'NO' Level and Characterisation are runtime expressions testing Q_01_009 against the invalid literals 'SUPER_INTENSIVE'/'INTENSIVE'/'SEMI-INTENSIVE'. Same dead-code shape as NQ 9's NO option; the sibling question Q_02_032 uses the correct short codes.
